item.title: Drew Brees and Larry Fitzgerald headline a Hall of Fame class missing Bill Belichick
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Drew Brees and Larry Fitzgerald headlined the 2026 Pro Football Hall of Fame class featuring five players but not six-time Super Bowl winning head coach Bill Belichick. Brees and Fitzgerald both made it in their first year of eligibility in results announced at NFL Honors on Thursday night after prolific careers. [...]

item.title: Jefferson Parish announces changes to bus routes for Mardi Gras season
item.description: Jefferson Parish Transit announced bus service changes for the 2026 Carnival Season. It will be effective Friday, Feb. 6, through Tuesday, Feb. 17. Bus detours go into effect two hours before parades begin and return to normal service once the parade has cleared.

item.title: Community gathers to honor fallen Jefferson Parish deputy
item.description: Hundreds of people gathered for the funeral of Christopher Ohlmeyer, the 41-year-old Jefferson Parish deputy who was killed when his motorcycle was hit on Airline Highway.
